🌟 Five-Star Experience at Boarding Bungalow!🌟

I cannot recommend Boarding Bungalow highly enough! Located in Dallas, Texas, they have become an essential part of our family by caring for our two dogs. From the moment we started bringing our pups here, it felt like an extension of our home.

The staff at Boarding Bungalow are not only loving and attentive but also excel at reinforcing the training in our dogs. They keep them active and engaged, ensuring they get plenty of exercise and playtime. It’s evident that they genuinely care for the well-being of every pet in their care.

Every time we pick up our dogs, they come home happy, healthy, and well-loved. It's such a relief to know that while we're away, our furry family members are in such capable hands. If you're looking for a reliable, caring, and professional boarding facility, look no further than Boarding Bungalow!

Thank you for everything you do! 🐾❤️

Thank you so much, Michelle! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your experience. It means a lot to our team!

We’re glad you had a great visit, and we look forward to seeing you and your pup again soon 🐾
This is the second time my Nina Baby has been to Boarding Bungalow. I absolutely love the way they care for her. And she always comes home so happy 😁 thanks for always taking care of my fur baby

This was my second time boarding here and the experience was just as great as the first. Everything was seamless and well organized. Michael was extremely helpful and accommodating — he waited for Khloé and me during both drop-off and pick-up, which I truly appreciated. Thank you all for the excellent care and service. Highly recommend — 10/10!

I was disappointed that when my dog was bitten by another dog, Boarding Bungalow did not call to inform me. Accidents happen, but I would have preferred that they call me, my vet, or my listed emergency contact if they suspected my dog was injured.
I love this place and so does my precious dog Sophie.   Sophie is so happy there.  Great staff and fun for our sweet pets.
Jade is amazing! She is a pro with grooming/ nail trimming.  Our pups having been going to Boarding Bungalow for 3+ years and have been pampered there while we are on vacation.  highly recommend!

The below statement was not issued by the owner, of which I happen to be.  This statement has no rational basis.  
The individual above is a former employee, the individual who responded as owner, I can only speculate. However, I can be certain that individual no longer works for us. 


Thank you so much for the positive feedback, Jamarcus! We are thrilled to hear that you were happy with the care your dog, Cosmo, received. We love our furry guests and always strive to provide the best service possible. Again, thank you!  See you and Cosmo again soon!

The facility is cute and kept very clean, and the yards are comfortable with nice tree shade for the dogs. What sets this kennel apart, however, is the staff. When you board your pet somewhere, that’s ultimately who you’re trusting, and what you’re taking a risk on. The bells and whistles of a facility might appeal to us humans, but it’s the staff who make or break the experience for our pets. Quality of attention and skill of care make all the difference. Kylee and Maddox put my mind at ease about entrusting them with the care of my beloved but energetic pup. Her comfort with them despite her anxious personality says everything to me! Highly recommend!

Update: disappointed to hear they have laid off the staff and hired a new manager with a questionable record. I would no longer recommend boarding here
Love them! Kylee and the team are excellent with the dogs! They love them and dogs are so happy going in and coming home!! Definitely recommend for boarding, daycare, and bathing needs!

Thank you, Crystal, for your wonderful review! We appreciate your support and are delighted to know you had a great experience at Boarding Bungalow. We look forward to welcoming you and your pet again soon!

We have been going to Boarding Bungalow since 2016.  It recently changed owners and is still going through some changes.  What hasn’t changed is the quality of care for your furry family member.  The owner and manager have worked with me on purchase package terms that weren’t clear at time of purchase.  We will continue to go here and trust the care for our pets

Ruca and Dingo enjoyed their vacation and I enjoyed receiving picture updates. Caring and devoted staff, wonderful rates, and genuine love for animals keeps us coming back! Can not recommend enough. ❤ 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 …
